rows.name: Sorry flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Pale roses, white tulips, freesias and a small box of pastel flowers — quiet rather than grand, which is usually the right register when you are apologising. A printed card is free and worth using here. Order by the cutoff shown for the destination and it arrives on the date you pick. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Sorry flowers: apology flowers delivered across Europe
